title: The Bakery Smell Is Fake
sendTrigger: Send this to someone who thinks grocery shopping is neutral.

copy.headline: That fresh bread smell when you walk in? It's pumped through the vents.

zones.label: HVAC unit
zones.note: Pipes bakery scent through the vents near the entrance.

zones.label: Scent zone, first ~20 feet
zones.note: The smell triggers hunger before you've picked up a basket.

copy.headline: It's called "scent marketing."
copy.body: Many grocery chains pipe bakery scent through HVAC systems near the entrance.

copy.headline: The smell doesn't make you hungry. It makes you slow down.

before.label: Rotisserie chicken

copy.headline: The bait and the hook
copy.body: The smell pulls you into the hot-food section, where margins run 60%+.

copy.headline: Nothing in the store is accidental.
copy.body: Fresh flowers at the entrance. Warm lighting in produce. Cool lighting on the meat to make it look redder.

copy.headline: You're not shopping. You're being directed.
copy.ctaLine: fond shows you what you actually need before you walk in.
